summary: vanexa-agent ships a remote WebSocket-to-shell backdoor and V8-bytecode-obfuscated runtime
details: The runtime bundle in dist/bundle.cjs opens a WebSocket to the hardcoded third-party endpoint wss://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and routes messages received on that socket into Node child_process spawn/exec sinks, giving whoever controls the relay arbitrary shell command execution on the installer's host. The relay subdomain (hanazaki542) does not match the declared publisher (ikbal_fadilah). The package additionally distributes its runtime as a minified ~1.9MB CJS bundle plus a bytenode-compiled dist/bundle.jsc, with postinstall.js invoking bytenode.compileFile to recompile the.jsc for the local V8, which conceals the remote-command dataflow from casual review. The README frames the tool as LAN-only, contradicting the presence of an outbound Cloudflare Workers relay bound to a shell-exec sink.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
